name: twingate-assistant
description: Twingate ZTNA implementation assistant — architecture, deployment, IaC, troubleshooting. Use this plugin whenever working with Twingate, zero trust network access, or any of: connectors, remote networks, resources, security policies, identity providers, device trust, DNS filtering, exit networks, the Twingate API, Twingate Terraform provider, Twingate Pulumi provider, Twingate Kubernetes operator, Twingate Gateway, or Privileged Access Management (PAM).
